title: Is New York (of All Places) About to Go Red?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每天晚上都会带着300件你最珍贵的传家宝去工作，你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了这样一个活生生的、充满美丽50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听由爱彼表呈献的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barrow.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: As Democratic Party leaders assessed their vulnerabilities in this year's midterm elections, the one state they did not worry about was New York.
sentences.zh: 正当民主党领袖们在今年的中期选举中评估他们的劣势时，他们唯一不担心的州就是纽约州。

sentences.en: That, it turns out, was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，那是一个错误。

sentences.en: My colleague, Nick Fandos, on why New York is suddenly up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·范多斯将为你解读为什么纽约州突然成了争夺的焦点。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: So, Nick, we have been talking on The Daily about the dawning realization that Republicans are doing better and better in the run-up to these midterm elections than they had been,
sentences.zh: 尼克，我们一直在《每日新闻》里探讨一种逐渐清晰的认识：在这些中期选举临近之际，共和党人的表现比以往越来越好，

sentences.en: and Democrats are, as a result, doing worse.
sentences.zh: 而结果就是民主党人的表现变差了。

sentences.en: But I think it's safe to say that nobody expected the Republican resurgence over the past few weeks to occur here in New York.
sentences.zh: 但我认为可以肯定地说，没有人预料到过去几周共和党的东山再起会发生在纽约。

sentences.en: The entire New York state government right now is Democratic.
sentences.zh: 目前整个纽约州政府完全由民主党掌控。

sentences.en: Governor, both parts of a legislature, here in New York City, mayor.
sentences.zh: 州长、立法机构的两院，以及纽约市的市长。

sentences.en: It's a blue state through and through.
sentences.zh: 这里是不折不扣的蓝州。

sentences.en: And yet, you're finding that the red tide of this moment is kind of lapping up against New York's shores.
sentences.zh: 然而，你却发现此刻的红色浪潮正在拍打着纽约的海岸。

sentences.en: So tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，给我们讲讲是怎么回事吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常引人注目。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, just two years ago, lost New York by 23 points.
sentences.zh: 就在两年前，唐纳德·特朗普在纽约输了23个百分点。

sentences.en: Biden won by 23 points.
sentences.zh: 拜登赢了23个百分点。

sentences.en: It's been 20 years since New York elected a Republican governor.
sentences.zh: 纽约选出一位共和党州长已经过去20年了。

sentences.en: It's been a long time since Republicans had much of a foothold in Albany.
sentences.zh: 自共和党在奥尔巴尼拥有大量根据地以来，已经过去很长时间了。

sentences.en: And yet, here we are, just two weeks before Election Day, as you say, and races all across the state, including for governor, have gotten way too close for Democrats' comfort.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如你所说，距离选举日只有两周了，我们却发现全州各地的竞选，包括州长竞选，都变得让民主党人感到过于胶着。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with that governor's race.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从州长竞选开始说起。

sentences.en: So, I think to tell the story, we've got to go back a little bit more than a year when Andrew Cuomo, the then popular and quite well-known domineering governor of New York,
sentences.zh: 我想为了讲述这个故事，我们得回到一年多以前，当时安德鲁·库默，这位当时受欢迎且相当著名的纽约强势州长，

sentences.en: runs full-on into a sexual harassment scandal.
sentences.zh: 一头陷入了性骚扰丑闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And ends up having to resign in August of 2021.
sentences.zh: 并最终不得不在2021年8月辞职。

sentences.en: And that elevates his lieutenant governor,
sentences.zh: 这使得他的副州长得以晋升，

sentences.en: Kathy Hochul.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·霍楚尔。

sentences.en: I, Kathy Hochul, you saw a woman?
sentences.zh: 我是凯茜·霍楚尔，你看到一个女性了吗？

sentences.en: Who is not particularly well-known, is really frankly...
sentences.zh: 她并不是特别出名，坦白说……

sentences.en: I don't think any of us really had heard much about her at all.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当中没有人真正对她有所耳闻。

sentences.en: No, she's an accidental governor in a way.
sentences.zh: 是的，某种程度上她是个意外上台的州长。

sentences.en: And she has a really difficult task upon taking office.
sentences.zh: 她一上任就面临着一项非常艰难的任务。

sentences.en: She basically has to learn how to become governor and start running for re-election simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 她基本上必须同时学会如何成为州长并开始竞选连任。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so she does something that I think nobody quite saw coming.
sentences.zh: 所以她做了一件我想象中没有人预料到的事。

sentences.en: She goes out and raises just a ridiculously large amount of money.
sentences.zh: 她走出去，筹集了简直是多得荒谬的资金。

sentences.en: Tens of millions of dollars over the course of just a few months.
sentences.zh: 在短短几个月内就筹集了数千万美元。

sentences.en: She puts together a very impressive campaign team.
sentences.zh: 她组建了一个非常令人印象深刻的竞选团队。

sentences.en: She scares better-known rivals,
sentences.zh: 她吓退了更有名的竞争对手，

sentences.en: Bill de Blasio,
sentences.zh: 比如白思豪，

sentences.en: Letitia James, out of the race.
sentences.zh: 以及莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯，让他们退出了竞选。

sentences.en: And by the time we get to the Democratic primary this past June, she basically walks over the competition and appears to be the dominant political force in the state of New York.
sentences.zh: 到了今年6月的民主党初选中，她几乎轻而易举地击败了竞争对手，看起来成了纽约州占绝对优势的政治力量。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as the frame starts to turn to the general election, that theme becomes even more so because her opponent, her Republican opponent,
sentences.zh: 正当聚光灯转向大选时，这个主题变得更加明显，因为她的对手，她的共和党对手，

sentences.en: Lee Zeldin, who's a conservative congressman from Long Island, doesn't seem like he'll be a plausible threat.
sentences.zh: 李·泽尔丁，一位来自长岛的保守派国会议员，看起来并不像是一个现实的威胁。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: This is a guy who racked up not only quite a conservative voting record in Washington, but he became one of the most visible and loyal allies of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这家伙不仅在华盛顿积累了相当保守的投票记录，而且还成为了唐纳德·特朗普最引人注目、最忠实的盟友之一。

sentences.en: What, if any, role do you think former President Trump played in the riot
sentences.zh: 你认为前总统特朗普在

sentences.en: January of 2021?
sentences.zh: 2021年1月的那场骚乱中发挥了什么作用（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: President Trump told his supporters to go peacefully and patriotically to the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统告诉他的支持者和平且爱国地前往国会大厦。

sentences.en: And in particular,
sentences.zh: 特别是，

sentences.en: Zeldin had helped amplify doubts about the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 泽尔丁曾帮助放大对2020年大选结果的怀疑。

sentences.en: Do you believe the continued claims by Donald Trump that the election was stolen from him?
sentences.zh: 你是否相信唐纳德·特朗普关于选举被窃取的持续说法？

sentences.en: Listen, it's something that we'll never, you know, for sure know the exact consequence of...
sentences.zh: 听着，这是我们永远，你知道的，无法确切知道其确切后果的事情……

sentences.en: Ultimately culminating in a couple of votes on January 6th to overturn the results in two key swing states.
sentences.zh: 最终在1月6日投下了几张推翻两个关键摇摆州结果的票。

sentences.en: So he was among those House Republicans who voted not to certify
sentences.zh: 所以他是那些投票反对认证

sentences.en: Joe Biden's victory.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登胜利的众议院共和党人之一。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没。

sentences.en: Which in New York certainly looked at the time like a non-starter.
sentences.zh: 在当时的纽约，这看起来绝对是痴人说梦。

sentences.en: Now, remember at the same time, the primaries here in New York actually wrapped up right after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v.
sentences.zh: 现在，请记住，与此同时，纽约的初选实际上在最高法院推翻罗诉

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案判决后不久就结束了。

sentences.en: Congressman Lee Zeldin tweeted, quote, today is a victory for life, for family, for the Constitution, and for federalism.
sentences.zh: 国会议员李·泽尔丁发推文称，引述一下，今天是生命、家庭、宪法和联邦制的胜利。

sentences.en: And Zeldin celebrated that decision.
sentences.zh: 泽尔丁为这一裁决欢呼雀跃。

sentences.en: He has a long record of anti-abortion votes.
sentences.zh: 他有着长期的反堕胎投票记录。

sentences.en: And Kathy Hochul was able to kind of step forward as a protector of abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 而凯茜·霍楚尔则得以站出来扮演堕胎权的捍卫者。

sentences.en: As the first female governor of New York, I take this personally.
sentences.zh: 作为纽约第一位女州长，我对此深有体会。

sentences.en: I refuse to go backwards.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝开倒车。

sentences.en: And I promise you, as long as I'm governor, we will not.
sentences.zh: 我向你们保证，只要我是州长，我们就绝不后退。

sentences.en: And for most of the summer, she puts that big campaign war chest to use.
sentences.zh: 在整个夏天的大部分时间里，她都在动用那笔庞大的竞选资金。

sentences.en: I'm not easily shaken, but I'm terrified Lee Zeldin could become governor.
sentences.zh: 我不容易被动摇，但我害怕李·泽尔丁会当选州长。

sentences.en: He's supported abortion bans so cruel.
sentences.zh: 他支持极其残酷的堕胎禁令。

sentences.en: And starts attacking Zeldin pretty mercilessly for his voting record in Washington, for his ties to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 并开始毫不留情地攻击泽尔丁在华盛顿的投票记录以及他与唐纳德·特朗普的联系。

sentences.en: Lee Zeldin is dangerous and too extreme for New York.
sentences.zh: 李·泽尔丁很危险，对纽约来说过于极端。

sentences.en: And this whole mix of issues, abortion and Trump and New York's Democratic lean, all made it look like this was basically going to be a cakewalk for the new Democratic governor.
sentences.zh: 所有这些议题的组合——堕胎、特朗普以及纽约偏向民主党的倾向——使得这一切看起来基本上会成为这位新民主党州长的轻松坦途。

sentences.en: And that's where we are as we head into this fall.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们进入今年秋天时的处境。

sentences.en: But what Hochul's campaign seems not to have seen at first is that while she is spending millions of dollars on TV and spending her time talking about how Lee Zeldin's too extreme
sentences.zh: 但霍楚尔的竞选团队起初似乎没有看到的是，正当她花数百万美元打电视广告并花时间谈论李·泽尔丁如何过于极端、

sentences.en: and his record's going to pull him down, the mood of the electorate is starting to shift.
sentences.zh: 他的记录会拖累他时，选民的心情开始发生变化。

sentences.en: And issues that had seemed dominant over the summer, not only in New York, but around the country, a woman's right to choose, the Trump presidency's threat to American democracy,
sentences.zh: 那些在夏天似乎占主导地位的议题，不仅在纽约，而且在全国范围内——女性的选择权、特朗普总统对美国民主的威胁，

sentences.en: start to be eclipsed by issues like cost of living and particularly fear about crime.
sentences.zh: 开始被生活成本以及尤其是对犯罪的恐惧等议题所掩盖。

sentences.en: Right, we talk about this a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们在节目中经常谈论这一点。

sentences.en: Issues favorable to Democrats over the summer, like abortion, have been supplanted pretty dramatically by issues favorable to Republicans, like crime.
sentences.zh: 夏天对民主党有利的议题，如堕胎，已经被对共和党有利的议题，如犯罪，相当戏剧性地取代了。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: And in New York, that has played right into the hands of Lee Zeldin, whose campaign from the start has been focused on crime.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，这正好迎合了李·泽尔丁下怀，他的竞选活动从一开始就聚焦于犯罪问题。

sentences.en: Now, you've got to pause for a second, I think, and say that crime is a complicated picture in New York.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想你得停顿一下，说说在纽约，犯罪情况其实很复杂。

sentences.en: Certain categories of crime have certainly gone up since the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 自大流行以来，某些类别的犯罪确实有所增加。

sentences.en: Others have been a bit flatter.
sentences.zh: 其他类别则较为平稳。

sentences.en: But there have
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问

sentences.en: unquestionably been these high-profile incidents.
sentences.zh: 发生过这些备受瞩目的事件。

sentences.en: You know, a guy on his way to brunch on a Sunday morning shot and killed on a subway car going into Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一个周日早晨在去早午餐路上的家伙在驶往曼哈顿的地铁车厢里被枪杀。

sentences.en: A shooting in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 时代广场发生枪击案。

sentences.en: A shooting in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 时代广场发生枪击案。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, that has created a sense of fear among a lot of New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这在许多纽约人心中制造了一种恐惧感。

sentences.en: And Zeldin is kind of speaking to it directly.
sentences.zh: 而泽尔丁正在直接谈论这一点。

sentences.en: We can recap the amount of crime from the last week.
sentences.zh: 我们可以回顾过去一周的犯罪数量。

sentences.en: And you'd think that we're recapping the amount of crime around the state over the course of the last year.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得我们是在回顾过去一年里全州的犯罪数量。

sentences.en: You know, at one point in the campaign, there was actually a shooting outside his own home on suburban Long Island in October.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在竞选过程中的某个时刻，10月份在他位于长岛郊区的家门外确实发生了一起枪击事件。

sentences.en: His daughters were doing homework and gunfire erupted outside.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿们正在做功课，屋外突然枪声大作。

sentences.en: They called him while he was out on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 他在外参加竞选活动时给他们打了电话。

sentences.en: You know, no one ended up dying, but it allowed Zeldin to argue that there was literally a trail of blood leading to his own front door.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，最终没有人死亡，但这让泽尔丁得以辩称，字面意义上的血路已经延伸到了他自家的前门。

sentences.en: Now I have to walk through crime scene tape in order to show up at my own front doorstep yesterday.
sentences.zh: 现在我昨天不得不穿过犯罪现场的警戒线才能出现在我自己的前门阶梯上。

sentences.en: This is getting worse every single day and the people in charge are not only not doing squat about it, they don't even want to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 这种情况每天都在恶化，当权者不仅对此屁都不放一个，甚至连谈都不愿意谈。

sentences.en: And more than just that, he has been very particular about blaming the Democrats and Governor Hochul for not only this rise, but not confronting it more aggressively.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还非常具体地指责民主党人和霍楚尔州长不仅导致了这种上升，而且没有更积极地去应对它。

sentences.en: And how does he blame them?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么指责他们的？

sentences.en: So, in New York, shortly before the pandemic, the Democratic legislature, and this predates
sentences.zh: 在纽约，在大流行爆发前不久，民主党立法机构（这发生在

sentences.en: Hochul's governorship, passed a set of changes to the state's bail laws that basically were designed to try and make the system fairer, particularly for black and brown people
sentences.zh: 霍楚尔当州长之前），通过了一套针对该州保释法的修改方案，其基本目的是试图让系统更公正，特别是对那些因轻微 petty 犯罪而被收监保释并因此受到不利影响的黑人和棕色人种而言。

sentences.en: who were being held on bail for small, petty crime and adversely affected by that.
sentences.zh: 被保释的人群。

sentences.en: What he says is the consequence is that people who are charged are being let out onto the street at much too rapid rate and then going on to commit additional crimes.
sentences.zh: 他说造成的后果是，被控犯罪的人以过快的速度被释放到街头，然后继续去犯下更多的罪行。

sentences.en: Basically, a small number of people are making
sentences.zh: 基本上，一小撮人正在让

sentences.en: New York much less safe.
sentences.zh: 纽约变得极不安全。

sentences.en: Now, the data is actually quite complicated on this.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于这一点的数据其实相当复杂。

sentences.en: There are experts that have looked at it and drawn kind of different conclusions, but wrapping that together with a sense of fear and frankly, hammering that message
sentences.zh: 有专家研究过并得出了不同的结论，但把这一点与恐惧感结合起来，坦白说，在霍楚尔并没有真正谈论它，或者以一种更加微妙、难以消化的方式谈论它的几个月里，一遍又一遍、反反复复地向选民灌输这种信息，

sentences.en: home for months over and over and over as Hochul was not really talking about it or talking about it in a much more kind of nuanced, hard-to-digest way, appears to be working
sentences.zh: 似乎对泽尔丁很有效。

sentences.en: for Zeldin.
sentences.zh: 对泽尔丁很有效。

sentences.en: This race, which was once an 18, 20,
sentences.zh: 这场原本让霍楚尔领先18、20、

sentences.en: 22-point lead for Hochul, has now narrowed considerably into a set of polls in the last couple of weeks that have shown her just ahead by eight, six, in one case,
sentences.zh: 22个百分点的竞选，在过去几周的一系列民调中已经大幅缩小，显示她仅领先8个、6个百分点，在一个案例中甚至

sentences.en: even just four points, which is far closer than we have seen in a statewide election in New York, particularly for governor, in decades.
sentences.zh: 只有4个百分点，这比我们几十年来在纽约州级选举中（尤其是州长选举中）看到的要近得多。

sentences.en: And Nick, where has Governor Hochul's support been eroding geographically, and where has Zeldin's support been growing?
sentences.zh: 尼克，从地理上看，霍楚尔州长的支持率一直在哪里流失，泽尔丁的支持率又在哪里增长？

sentences.en: So, Zeldin's base of support has always been in the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 所以，泽尔丁的支持基础一直都在郊区。

sentences.en: That's where he's from.
sentences.zh: 那是他出身的地方。

sentences.en: That's where his kind of viewpoint seems to be.
sentences.zh: 那是他的观点所在的地方。

sentences.en: And that's where he is gaining the most ground and Hochul seems to be losing the most ground.
sentences.zh: 这也是他获得最多阵地、霍楚尔似乎失去最多阵地的地方。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: I'm talking about
